reason: Free and they load the flyers themselves, so I'd say yes to the listing since it costs me nothing and no time. I wouldn't pay a cent until I see the app actually has people in my city.
objection: I don't have time to manage another platform, and I've paid for Instagram boosts that gave me no real numbers. Until there are real users it's just one more thing that does nothing for my Friday nights.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the published monthly active user number pass 2,000 and clear stats showing how many people viewed and saved my nights, so I could compare it with what I get from my PR guys.
